reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, 5.07 ha polygon, status notified; no completed felling overlap (0%).

One eligible species within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (garnlav, VU, lichen, site-bound, forest-associated; threats include lack of continuity forest and large/old trees). 4 records from 2020, nearest 12 m from the polygon edge, 25 m uncertainty.
Three site-bound forest NT species also recorded within 250 m, all 2020 (Lobaria pulmonaria 100 m, Chaenotheca subroscida 196 m, Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum 250 m). Supporting evidence.
Effort is adequate (321 records, 115 species, 94th percentile vs county median 15). Near-site there is 1 record inside the polygon and 9 within 250 m, all from one observation day.

uncertainties: All red-listed records are from 2020 and from a single observation day; current presence is unknown.
The Phellinidium record sits exactly at 250 m, at the ring edge.
not_established: Whether the species occupy the polygon today
Forest condition or biodiversity of the site
next_action: Reviewer should compare the 2020 garnlav record positions (12 m and 97 m away) with the polygon boundary and consider a field inventory before felling begins.
